roadmap.title: Finish the scenario and legacy campaigns
roadmap.description: Complete Driver Training, Senseless Destruction, A Rocky Start, and Hustle and Bustle from the current mission interface or the legacy More menu. Handle the four finite activities first so their driving counts toward the distance achievement.

roadmap.title: Clean up the 1,000 km distance
roadmap.description: After the campaign achievements, use a fast vehicle on an official Freeroam map until the remaining distance toward 1,000 km registers.

achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{More > Campaigns > Senseless Destruction} and pass all @mechanic{11 levels} to finish the campaign.

guide.context: The unlock is tied to completing the full Senseless Destruction campaign. No specific medal tier is required, so passing each level is more important than improving its score.

steps.text: From the main menu, open @mechanic{More}, select @mechanic{Campaigns}, and start @mechanic{Senseless Destruction}.
Pass each of the campaign's @mechanic{11 levels} and continue until the campaign completion screen appears.
Allow the campaign to return to its ending state and confirm that Steam unlocks @mechanic{Senseless Destructor}.

achievements.summary: At the @loc{ETK Driver Experience Center}, open the map with @mechanic{M} and complete the @mechanic{Driver Training} activity.

guide.context: Driver Training moved out of the old career section and into ETK Driver Experience. Some installations also expose the same one-level activity as the main-menu scenario named Beginning.

steps.text: Launch BeamNG.drive through Steam, enter Freeroam, and load the @loc{ETK Driver Experience Center}.
Press @mechanic{M}, locate @mechanic{Driver Training} on the map, and start the training activity.
Complete the Driver Training challenges until Steam unlocks @mechanic{Beginner's Racing License}.
If Driver Training is not shown at the ETK center, return to the main menu, open @mechanic{More > Scenarios > Beginning}, and finish that single-level scenario.

achievements.description: Experience the start of the story
achievements.summary: Complete all @mechanic{6 levels} of @mechanic{More > Campaigns > A Rocky Start}, using the faint white map circles when mission markers are missing.

guide.context: This legacy campaign has used different map behavior across game versions. If labeled mission markers are missing, the faint white circles on the regular map still identify the campaign destinations.

steps.text: From the main menu, open @mechanic{More > Campaigns}, start @mechanic{A Rocky Start}, and complete the introductory challenge that has you push junk from a cliff.
Open the regular map, ignore the ordinary points of interest, and locate the @mechanic{very faint white circles} that mark the campaign challenges.
Drive to the white-circle locations and complete the next @mechanic{3 challenges} in any order.
Complete the remaining @mechanic{2 challenges} as they unlock sequentially, then continue to the campaign completion screen.
Confirm that finishing the sixth campaign level unlocks @mechanic{A Rocky Start} on Steam.

achievements.description: That's it! All scenes perfectly in the can!
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{More > Campaigns > Hustle and Bustle} and pass all @mechanic{6 levels} to finish the bus campaign.

guide.context: The achievement tracks completion of the Hustle and Bustle campaign. The word “perfectly” in the Steam description does not add a separate perfect-score or medal requirement.

steps.text: From the main menu, open @mechanic{More}, select @mechanic{Campaigns}, and start @mechanic{Hustle and Bustle}.
Pass all @mechanic{6 levels} and continue until the Hustle and Bustle campaign reaches its completion screen.
Allow the campaign ending to register and confirm that Steam unlocks @mechanic{Outstanding Performance}.

achievements.description: Drive 1000km. You're officially on the road!
achievements.summary: Accumulate @mechanic{1,000 km driven} on official maps; use a fast vehicle in @loc{Grid, Small, Pure} for any remaining distance.

guide.context: Only distance driven on official maps counts. Complete the scenario and campaigns first so their driving contributes before starting a dedicated distance session.

steps.text: Finish Driver Training and the three campaign achievements before beginning the dedicated distance cleanup.
Open Freeroam, load the official map @loc{Grid, Small, Pure}, and select a fast vehicle.
Keep driving on the official map until your cumulative distance reaches @mechanic{1,000 km} and Steam unlocks @mechanic{Kilometer Kickoff}.
